query.name: cleanup-recipe-build-step
query.comment: Cleanup the build steps of a recipe.
query.sql: DELETE FROM porion_build_step WHERE build_id IN (SELECT id FROM porion_build WHERE recipe_id = :recipe_id)

query.name: cleanup-recipe-build-metrics
query.sql: DELETE FROM porion_build_metric WHERE build_id IN (SELECT porion_build.id FROM porion_build WHERE porion_build.recipe_id = :recipe_id)

query.name: cleanup-recipe-build-queue
query.comment: Remove the recipe from build queue.

query.name: cleanup-recipe-test-run
query.comment: Cleanup the test run of all builds for the recipe.
query.sql: DELETE FROM porion_test_run WHERE group_id IN (SELECT porion_test_run_group.id FROM porion_test_run_group INNER JOIN porion_test_group ON porion_test_run_group.group_id = porion_test_group.id INNER JOIN porion_build ON porion_build.id = porion_test_group.build_id WHERE porion_build.recipe_id = :recipe_id)

query.name: cleanup-recipe-test-run-group
query.comment: Cleanup the test run group of all builds for the recipe.
query.sql: DELETE FROM porion_test_run_group WHERE group_id IN (SELECT id FROM porion_test_group INNER JOIN porion_build ON porion_build.id = porion_test_group.build_id WHERE porion_build.recipe_id = :recipe_id)

query.name: cleanup-recipe-last-build
query.comment: Cleanup the project last build references of a recipe.

query.name: cleanup-recipe-build
query.comment: Cleanup the project builds of a recipe.

query.name: cleanup-recipe-step
query.comment: Cleanup the project build recipe steps.
